note: Applying memory, not recalling text: each task names something an operator would have to do, and the answer is scored on whether the exact token needed to act — a flag, an interval, a bound — reached the reader. Tokens are verified to appear verbatim in the gold page, so a correct retrieval always can pass. What this does not measure is whether an agent then acts on it.
